name: 60619 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60619 (Chicago) has 325 nonprofit organizations. 118 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 85 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60619 (Chicago) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60619 (Chicago) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 85 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Community organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 9 community organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: 43 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
